run_optimizer_loop: run the DeepMimic optimizer loop by calling update_world in a continuous while loop
shutdown_rl_world: shutdown the RL world and log the shutdown message using Logger
build_and_run_world: build an RL world from CLI args and run the DeepMimic optimization loop
review_run_function: review the run function that loops calling update_world with the current timestep
refactor_main_entry: refactor the main entry point to support headless or drawing mode for the RL world
